mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in three ways: attributively, predicatively and substantively."
Adjectives in Greek are used in three ways: attributively, predicatively and substantively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in the Greek language along with abstract nouns though this usage is not found in English language."
Articles are used in the Greek language along with abstract nouns though this usage is not found in English language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the verse that describes the activities of the Samaritan in his bid to help the wounded man."
The verse in contention is the verse that describes the activities of the Samaritan in his bid to help the wounded man.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most certain ways of identifying the perfect tense of a verb."
The irregular accent is one of the most certain ways of identifying the perfect tense of a verb.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a secondary tense because it deals with the actions in the past time."
The aorist is a secondary tense because it deals with the actions in the past time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the same as those of the first aorist except in the third personal plural form where - κ ζι is more frequent than - κ ν."
The endings are the same as those of the first aorist except in the third personal plural form where - κ ζι is more frequent than - κ ν.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to give a vivid representation of what was going on in past time."
The descriptive imperfect is used to give a vivid representation of what was going on in past time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the forms of verbs that are used to form complex tenses."
Participles are the forms of verbs that are used to form complex tenses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted."
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when the subject is being acted upon by an outside agent."
The passive voice in the Greek is used when the subject is being acted upon by an outside agent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fourth principal part in the lexicon."
The perfect active stem is the fourth principal part in the lexicon.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Greek tense of completed action with a resultant state of being."
The perfect tense is the Greek tense of completed action with a resultant state of being.
fib: ______ is the use of the first-person plural form of the verb to exhort other people to join in an action that is deemed beneficial to all.
hortatory subjunctive
The hortatory subjunctive is the use of the first-person plural form of the verb to exhort other people to join in an action that is deemed beneficial to all.
______ is used to depict the general circumstances of Jesus' ministry rather than one singular occurrence.
periphrastic imperfect
The periphrastic imperfect is used to depict the general circumstances of Jesus' ministry rather than one singular occurrence.
______ are a special class of υ verbs.
Contrast verbs
Contrast verbs are a special class of υ verbs.
______ is the use of the second person aorist subjunctive to express a negative entreaty or command.
prohibitive subjunctive
The prohibitive subjunctive is the use of the second person aorist subjunctive to express a negative entreaty or command.
______ is used to express a question which is either a mere rhetorical device expecting no answer at all or a real question which expects an answer in the imperative.
deliberative subjunctive
The deliberative subjunctive is used to express a question which is either a mere rhetorical device expecting no answer at all or a real question which expects an answer in the imperative.
______ is used to express emphatic negation.
subjunctive
The subjunctive is used to express emphatic negation.
______ are the pronouns that are used to introduce direct or indirect questions.
interrogative pronouns
The interrogative pronouns are the pronouns that are used to introduce direct or indirect questions.
______ is used like the other participles.
aorist passive participle
The aorist passive participle is used like the other participles.
______ is used only in the present and the aorist tense in the New Testament Greek.
subjunctive mood
The subjunctive mood is used only in the present and the aorist tense in the New Testament Greek.
______ is a tense that expresses a past time.
secondary tense in the Greek
A secondary tense in the Greek is a tense that expresses a past time.
______ is used to express purpose and probable future condition.
final subjunctive
The final subjunctive is used to express purpose and probable future condition.
